description: Land Acquisition - Ihala Bopitiya, Pelmadulla D/S Division, Ratnapura District - Neluwa, Neluwa D/S Division, Galle District - Amendment, Ex. Gaz. No. 1816/23 dated 26th June 2013, Dutugamunu, Dehiwala D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively concerns land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains multiple notices for acquiring specific land parcels for public purposes, including detailed descriptions of the lands, their locations, extents, and the legal process for compensation claims. This fits perfectly within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) which covers land acquisitions, transfers, and property-related administrative matters.
